- Keyboard: a long copy shows in the bar's quick paste again (the clipboard list was saved on the main thread, which took seconds or failed with a long text; a copy that fails to come over is read again half a second later).
- Keyboard: copied links lose their trackers (utm_…, fbclid, gclid, YouTube / Spotify "si" …): the bar and the clipboard get the clean link (Settings > Keyboard, on by default).
- Keyboard (ideas from WM Keyboard, MIT): new tools for the bar and the ⋮ menu: open an app (the letters before the cursor filter the list), flashlight, search the web (the selection or the line), set an alarm from a time typed ("7:30", "7 pm", "in 10 min", "10 dk sonra").
- Keyboard: Settings > Keyboard > Learned words > Import a file takes another keyboard's personal dictionary: Gboard's export (zip), a word list of HeliBoard, FUTO or SwiftKey, or a CSV; its shortcuts become Pulse shortcuts.
- Keyboard: Emoji mix tool: the two emoji before the cursor become one picture (Google's Emoji Kitchen) that goes into the chat.
- Keyboard: five more key press splashes in the style of Keys Cafe (paint, ink, confetti, hearts, bubbles).
- Keyboard: your own touch sound and key font from a file (Settings > Keyboard > Look).
